_comment: Reference analog sites studied by space-agency / research teams in or next to each Earth zone. Used ONLY to check results after they are computed: never an input of the similarity model. Coordinates: decimal degrees (south and west negative). 'zone' = Earth zone id in config.EARTH_ZONES.

sites.name: Licancabur summit lake

sites.studied_for: Lake in a 5,900 m volcanic crater: thin air, intense UV, cold - analog of martian crater paleolakes
